rightsRule: Use only member portraits from official Congress.gov member profiles with source attribution.
notes: Verified as a useful source for current U.S. House incumbents; dedicated discovery script is wired into enrichment.

rightsRule: Use only portraits on official Office of the Clerk member profiles with source attribution.
notes: Verified as a useful source for current U.S. House incumbents; dedicated discovery script is wired into enrichment.

rightsRule: Use portraits hosted on official Texas Judicial Branch judge or justice biography pages with source attribution.
notes: Verified on Third Court of Appeals biographies and statewide judicial profiles.

rightsRule: Use portraits hosted on official State Board of Education member pages with source attribution.
notes: Existing verified source for SBOE incumbents.

rightsRule: Use candidate-slate portraits on the official Libertarian Party of Texas candidates page with party attribution and a source link.
notes: Verified 2026 statewide, congressional, legislative, and county candidate slate with candidate portraits.

rightsRule: Use portraits on the official Green Party of Texas nominated-candidates page with party attribution and a source link.
notes: Existing verified source for Green Party nominees.

rightsRule: Approve only after item-level verification that the file depicts the candidate and carries a compatible reusable license or public-domain status; preserve the exact file-page source and license attribution.
searchHint: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File candidate name official portrait Texas
notes: Verified as a high-value source for public-domain U.S. Congress portraits and other properly licensed candidate images. Existing Wikimedia discovery remains subject to item-level identity and rights checks.

rightsRule: Use only items whose DVIDS page explicitly marks the image Public Domain and whose caption clearly identifies the candidate; preserve photographer, agency, image-page attribution, and any DVIDS copyright restrictions.
notes: DVIDS contains high-resolution public-domain military and federal-government event photography. Prefer formal portraits when available; use DVIDS as a fallback after item-level review.

rightsRule: Use the directory to locate official and campaign websites; do not automatically copy directory portrait assets without documenting image provenance or reuse basis.
notes: High-value directory containing portraits plus official and campaign links for Texas Republican officeholders.

rightsRule: Use candidate pages to locate official campaign sites and downstream image sources; do not auto-approve party-page images unless provenance is documented.
notes: Confirmed 2026 ballot/candidate directory; use for source discovery only.

rightsRule: Do not auto-approve merely because the page is governmental; many images are explicitly courtesy of the Member. Verify the linked rights/reproduction terms or obtain a stronger source.
notes: High-recall identity and portrait-discovery source, but reuse rights require item-level review.

rightsRule: Treat as candidate identification/source discovery unless the image provenance or editorial reuse basis is documented.
notes: Live 2026 candidate slate with candidate images; useful for finding campaign links and downstream sources.

rightsRule: Use to locate verified campaign/government webpages; do not copy portrait assets without documented reusable rights.
notes: Useful source-expansion directory because profiles expose verified webpages and current-office context.

rightsRule: Do not use licensable assets unless KeepTXRed has a valid license for the specific image.
notes: Useful only as evidence that event photography exists; not a free image source.

rightsRule: Use only records whose item page clearly identifies the candidate and confirms public-domain/no-known-copyright-restrictions status or another compatible reuse basis. Preserve the National Archives record URL and creator attribution.
notes: New source class: the U.S. National Archives catalog contains official federal portraits and event photography that can be reusable when the individual record supports it.

rightsRule: Approve only when the Library of Congress item-level Rights & Access or rights advisory supports reuse. Preserve the item URL, collection/creator credit, and rights statement.
notes: New source class for historical and public-domain candidate imagery; item-level rights vary and must be checked.

rightsRule: Use only Smithsonian items explicitly marked Public Domain or CC0/Open Access on the item page; preserve Smithsonian collection and item attribution.
notes: New source class. Smithsonian Open Access can supply clearly rights-marked historical political portraits.

rightsRule: Use PICRYL only to discover the originating NARA, DVIDS, Library of Congress, or other source record. Do not auto-approve the aggregator copy; verify rights and identity on the originating record whenever available.
searchHint: site:picryl.com candidate name Texas politician portrait
notes: New discovery source that indexes NARA, DVIDS, Library of Congress, and other public-domain collections; origin verification remains required.

rightsRule: Approve only after verifying the exact image's Creative Commons license permits the intended reuse, the image clearly depicts the candidate, and attribution requirements are preserved. Reject All Rights Reserved items.
searchHint: site:flickr.com/photos candidate name Texas politician Creative Commons
notes: New source class for candidate and public-event photos where the individual Flickr item carries a compatible Creative Commons license.

rightsRule: Use Openverse to find candidate images, then verify identity, license, creator, and source on the originating item page before approval.
notes: New source-discovery index for Creative Commons and public-domain media; never treat index metadata alone as sufficient rights verification.
